fact: Digital Policy Alert records that Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024, adopted by Parliament on 4 April 2024, entered into force on 24 July 2024 and requires data controllers and processors to store locally collected personal data on servers in Ethiopia.

The Ministry of Innovation and Technology says the Digital Ethiopia 2030 strategy is grounded in digital sovereignty, with a sovereign national cloud and strict enforcement of data sovereignty laws as its backbone.
